snippet.title: Elusive - Official Gameplay Trailer | The MIX Summer Showcase 2025
snippet.description:
Check out gameplay and get a deep dive into Elusive in this new trailer for the upcoming adventure platformer Metroidvania game. Elusive will be available on PC, PS5 (PlayStation 5), Xbox, and Nintendo Switch. 
The Elusives are tiny creatures that inhabit our homes, hiding from us and borrowing whatever they need. Humans are so big and clumsy that they do not perceive the world full of adventure and resources that extends before their feet.
